purpose: Generate one coherent three-pose source panel for component extraction only. It is never a runtime full-face sheet or animation playback resource.

panel_contract.layout: one unbordered horizontal row of exactly three equally sized, centered faces on white, ordered menu_active, recording_active, charging_active, with no labels
panel_contract.runtime_rule: The panel is art-source provenance only. Later runtime can export only separable registered components and may never show or cycle the three whole faces.
panel_contract.identity: Each pose retains the exact locked V9 open eye silhouette, black fill, one primary oval highlight and one diamond sparkle per eye, scale, spacing, baseline, nose and monochrome ink weight.

poses.face: clear friendly brow asymmetry, both legal highlights biased toward the same chosen direction, a small closed decisive mouth and compact quiet cheeks
poses.motion_read: a deterministic later highlight scan through left, center, right, then an eyebrow decision landing

poses.face: paired soft high brows, attentive legal highlights, a compact round listening mouth and gently opened cheeks
poses.integral_action: one extremely short inward-facing ear-perk stroke directly attached behind each outer cheek; no free arcs, spirals, waves or glyphs
poses.motion_read: cheek-attached ear perks once, then a small response-mouth acknowledgement

poses.face: outward-released brows, soft settled legal highlights, an unmistakably warm compact recovery smile and lifted cheeks
poses.motion_read: a deterministic Daily-to-recovery brow release and smile arrival, slow hold, then exact reverse

rejection_conditions: any label, border, UI icon, punctuation, heart, star, microphone, waveform, battery, plug, bolt or color
changed eye silhouettes or unmatched eye geometry across the three poses
outside recording's two cheek-attached ear-perk strokes, any floating accent mark
recording resembles broadcast decoration rather than listening
charging resembles sleep, surprise or a generic Daily smile
the panel is reused as a runtime card or frame sequence
required_followup: archive the exact prompt before image generation and archive generated panel path plus SHA-256 before any crop
use a source gate to prove V9-only input, panel order, identity invariants and forbidden-mark absence
export only components, produce deterministic causal action choreography and prove browser/target component-plan parity at native 200x200
keep runtime inactive and unbound through machine closure and human review
